statement: Provide a layer manager to create, rename, delete and set current layers and to edit each layer's visibility, freeze, lock, color, linetype, lineweight, transparency, plot style, plot flag, viewport overrides and description, with filtering and column sorting.
superiority: Layer table with live search, per-viewport state shown inline.

acceptance.sketch: Create layer A color 1 lineweight 0.35; freeze: objects vanish and do not regen; lock: objects visible but not editable; DWG round trip keeps all flags.

notes: Verified against help page "LAYER (Command)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-B297EBD9-D68C-47E1-87CE-1B3798496599 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Layer, Layers, LayerOff, LayerOn, LayerLock; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Offer a command-line layer interface with options to list, make, set, create, rename, switch on/off, freeze/thaw, lock/unlock, and assign color, linetype, lineweight, transparency, material, plot flag, plot style and description, plus layer state, reconcile and xref-reset sub-options.
superiority: Typed layer script is idempotent and transactional.

acceptance.sketch: -LAYER Make X creates and sets X current; -LAYER Freeze A,B freezes both; wildcards select multiple.

notes: Verified against help page "-LAYER (Command)". | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Layer; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Support layer property filters (wildcard name plus state/property columns, with AND within a row and OR across rows) and layer group filters populated by dragging layers, with nested filters and removal.

source.ref: To Work with the Layer List in the Layer Properties Manager

superiority: Smart filters are saved per project.

acceptance.sketch: Filter "WALL*" shows only matches; group filter holds explicit membership; inverted filter inverts.

notes: Verified against help page "To Work with the Layer List in the Layer Properties Manager". Corrected: No inverse (reverse) filter is documented on the page; nesting rule: a group filter can nest only under another group filter. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-1F03EFC1-B178-48F3-A98E-B69952527A46 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Allow saving, restoring, editing, renaming, deleting, importing (LAS/DWG/DWS/DWT) and exporting (LAS) of named layer states, with a per-property mask selecting which layer settings get restored.
superiority: States can be applied per viewport and per sheet.

acceptance.sketch: Save state S1; change colors; restore only On/Off: colors stay; export LAS and import into another drawing restores.

notes: Verified against help page "LAYERSTATE (Command)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-3E0F662B-226F-4A27-B5BB-D15252CC994C ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-64C21BD6-4DA6-48CE-9D81-CC98167BCA55 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers LayerState, LayerStateManager; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Let each layout viewport override freeze/thaw, color, linetype, lineweight, transparency and plot style of layers without altering the layer's global settings, with indicators in the layer list and command-line control through VPLAYER.

source.ref: About Overriding Layer Properties in a Layout Viewport

acceptance.sketch: In viewport V1 layer A red; model layer A stays blue; plot shows red in V1 only; override removal restores.

notes: Verified against help page "About Overriding Layer Properties in a Layout Viewport". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-EB4DA3DA-5466-4D48-9AEC-6828B82BDEF9 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-C96B67FA-B992-4C49-BB72-FB3E44FFB6BC | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Allow the current layer to be set from the layer manager (CLAYER), from a selected object (LAYMCUR), and from the Layers panel, and refuse frozen or xref layers as current.

acceptance.sketch: Pick object on layer W: LAYMCH-like current is W; LAYERP restores previous.

notes: Verified against help page "About Layers". Corrected: LAYERP does not restore a previously current layer; it undoes the latest layer-settings change. Separate row for LAYERP exists. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-E44FA50E-DB98-48C4-AE6B-052ED7287497 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers ChangeToCurrentLayer, SetLayer; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Isolate the layers of selected objects by turning off, viewport-freezing or locking-and-fading all other layers, and let LAYUNISO restore the layer settings that existed before isolation.

acceptance.sketch: LAYISO off others with Lock mode and 50% fade: others locked and faded; LAYUNISO restores previous states.

notes: Verified against help page "LAYISO (Command)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-0795CBC9-7A9D-4A36-B49E-244C146FF6EA | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Isolate; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: LAYOFF and LAYFRZ turn off or freeze the layers of selected objects, while LAYON and LAYTHW turn on or thaw every layer in the drawing.

acceptance.sketch: LAYOFF picks object: its layer turns off; LAYON turns all on; LAYFRZ freezes; LAYTHW thaws.

notes: Verified against help page "LAYOFF (Command)". Corrected: Original said all four act on selected objects or all layers; only LAYOFF/LAYFRZ take a selection, LAYON/LAYTHW are drawing-wide. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-575562DA-547E-4247-8616-2F6684838B77 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-E7DB1E23-EB54-4DB7-B168-7725DFE6F100 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-8590F14F-49DE-40B1-AC90-44EB49ECC9AE | prior app hint: cand2 app registers LayerOff, LayerOn, AllLayersOn; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Lock or unlock the layer of a selected object (LAYLCK, LAYULK), with objects on locked layers drawn faded according to LAYLOCKFADECTL.

source.ref: To Lock or Unlock a Layer

acceptance.sketch: Locked layer objects cannot be selected for edit but snap works; fade by 50 percent.

notes: Verified against help page "To Lock or Unlock a Layer". statement: Provide LAYMCH to move selected objects onto the layer of a chosen destination object (or a named layer), LAYCUR to move selected objects onto the current layer, and LAYMCUR to make an object's layer current.

acceptance.sketch: LAYMCH: object A moves to B's layer; LAYCUR moves selection to current layer.

notes: Verified against help page "LAYMCH (Command)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-EA22341E-62F1-4C7D-9B14-F83526433C64 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-E44FA50E-DB98-48C4-AE6B-052ED7287497 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers MatchLayer, ChangeToCurrentLayer; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Delete a layer together with every object on it, remove the layer from the drawing, and also strip those objects from block definitions that use the layer.

acceptance.sketch: LAYDEL layer X erases objects on X and removes layer; blocks nested get purged; confirmation prompt.

notes: Verified against help page "LAYDEL (Command)". Corrected: The xref-warning behavior in the original is not documented on the page. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-D34784C7-4C6F-4DCE-B0F2-A26E97BD01F0 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Merge chosen layers into a target layer by moving their objects there and purging the emptied source layers.

acceptance.sketch: Merge A and B into C: all objects on A,B move to C; A,B no longer exist.

notes: Verified against help page "LAYMRG (Command)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-0976544F-76F9-444C-86D3-91BEAABECCD8 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Provide a layer-walk dialog that shows only objects on the layers picked in a list, hides all others, restores the original state when closed, and allows purging unreferenced layers.

acceptance.sketch: Select layer A: only A visible; exit restores states.

notes: Verified against help page "LAYWALK (Command)". | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Track layer-setting changes so LAYERP can undo the most recent change or batch of changes (not renames, deletions or additions), with LAYERPMODE switching the tracking on or off.

acceptance.sketch: LAYERP after freezing X restores X as thawed.

notes: Verified against help page "LAYERP (Command)". Corrected: Original said just 'undo last layer state change'; page lists non-undoable operations and the tracking switch. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-249DBD51-2A59-4932-9E63-591C293D7FE9 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Open a layer translator that maps the current drawing's layers onto the names and properties found in a chosen standards or reference drawing, saves and reuses mappings, and converts layers accordingly.

acceptance.sketch: Map WALL1 to A-WALL; objects move and properties match; mapping saved and reused.

notes: Verified against help page "LAYTRANS (Command)". Corrected: File types DWG/DWT/DWS are not confirmed on the page; it says 'a specified drawing or standards file'. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-F2793AC4-872D-40D1-8359-EDA51C51EEEA | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Isolate the layer of a picked object inside the active layout viewport by freezing that layer in every other viewport, for the current layout or all layouts, available only when the layout holds at least two viewports.

acceptance.sketch: LAYVPI freezes all layers except selected in current viewport only.

notes: Verified against help page "LAYVPI (Command)". Corrected: Original described freezing layers of selected objects in the current viewport; actual behavior freezes them in every other viewport. | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Provide LAYERCLOSE to close the layer manager palette from the command line.

acceptance.sketch: Palette persists state.

notes: Verified against help page "LAYERCLOSE (Command)". Corrected: Docking, floating, auto-hide and the filter tree are general palette/Layer Properties Manager UI behaviors not described on this page; add separate rows if wanted. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-B297EBD9-D68C-47E1-87CE-1B3798496599 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Support layer naming and migration against organizational layer standards, with layer translation between a drawing and a standards file.

acceptance.sketch: Name A-WALL-FULL parses to discipline A, major WALL, minor FULL.

notes: UNVERIFIED: No Autodesk help page found that mentions ISO 13567 or the AIA CAD Layer Guidelines; the closest topic is the layer translator. About Layers only suggests custom naming conventions. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-6B3E3B5D-3AE2-4162-A5FE-CFE42AB0743B | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Standards; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Provide per-layer transparency from 0 to 90 percent that always affects screen display and affects plots only when the plot transparency option is switched on.

source.ref: Layer Transparency Dialog Box (Layer Properties Manager)

acceptance.sketch: Transparency 50 percent draws half-alpha; PDF export alpha preserved.

notes: Verified against help page "Layer Transparency Dialog Box (Layer Properties Manager)". Corrected: Plotting of transparency is off by default and must be enabled in Plot/Page Setup. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-E6EB9CA5-B039-4262-BE17-1AD3E7230EF7 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-0908F1AC-D122-4B3D-A17C-8705D03A0D0C | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Objects created ByLayer take color, linetype and lineweight from their layer, while ByBlock objects use defaults until grouped into a block and then take the current setting of the inserted block.

source.ref: About Setting the Color of Objects

notes: Verified against help page "About Setting the Color of Objects". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-20B4D4B3-1220-426A-847B-5BBE36EC6FDF ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-4B33ACD3-F6DD-4CB5-8C55-D6D0D7130905 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Load linetypes from LIN definition files (including patterns with text and symbols) and support global scale (LTSCALE), per-object scale (CELTSCALE), paper space scaling (PSLTSCALE) and annotation-scale linetype scaling (MSLTSCALE).

acceptance.sketch: Load ACAD.LIN: DASHED draws pattern of given dash length times scale; complex linetype with text follows curve.

acceptance.sketch: Lineweight 0.5 mm prints at 0.5 mm; DWG lineweight enum round trip.

statement: Support ACI colors 1-255, True Color, and color books such as PANTONE, RAL and DIC, assignable ByLayer, ByBlock or explicitly, with color also driving lineweight in color-dependent plotting.
